The issue was in `/workspace/Bachmann1234__diff_cover__9.1/diff_cover/diff_reporter.py` at lines 172-173, where the `src_paths_changed()` method attempted to read all untracked files as UTF-8 text without proper filtering or error handling.

```python
# include untracked files
```
